reader_architecture.page_type: server-rendered HTML reader with dynamic section loading
reader_architecture.section_identifiers: HTML span.acar_span rel values; parent section IDs are embedded in nested li.dropdown anchors
reader_architecture.authentication: No login was required for the public reader observed
reader_architecture.csrf: The public page provides a CSRF token required by the reader request
reader_architecture.pagination: Section navigation is represented by the embedded table of contents; no separate public pagination API was identified

redirect_diagnosis.library_item_direct_request: Automated curl follows a www canonical redirect loop
redirect_diagnosis.reader_route: The public reader route loads in the browser and exposes the table of contents
redirect_diagnosis.likely_boundary: The redirect behavior is host/canonical-routing specific; no authentication or anti-bot bypass was attempted

verified_observations.library_identity: The official library page identifies the book as المسائل الاسلامية and publisher as مكتب المرجع الشيرازي
verified_observations.reader_structure: The reader exposes مقدمة المسائل الاسلامية, اصول الدين, فروع الدين, الاخلاق والآداب الاسلامية, and المسائل الاسلامية sections
verified_observations.first_content_sample: Selecting the public introduction returns HTML Arabic paragraphs beginning with بسم اللّه الرّحمن الرّحيم and the introduction text

quality_validation.reason: The browser session repeatedly timed out while expanding nested reader sections; no source text was accepted based on partial observation

decision.next_step: Build a bounded, read-only harvester for the public reader endpoint, collect 25+ cross-check passages across the book, run unchanged Phase 5 gates, then build an isolated source-only database if and only if the complete corpus passes.
